name: sendwhale
description: Import your brand and create editable email drafts in SendWhale from your AI conversation.

interface.longDescription: Turn your email brief into editable SendWhale drafts. Import a public website to detect brand colors, fonts, images and reference content, then review what was found. Use your saved brand guidance to write one email or a series of up to twelve emails. Save the designs into Swell's canvas, reopen your own saved draft conversation, and revise unsent campaigns. The connected assistant writes the content using its own model. A SendWhale account and workspace are required. Website imports may need manual corrections. This plugin cannot send or schedule email, change billing, or access private inboxes. Delivery requires human review in SendWhale. Only the short task brief you choose to share is saved; your full external chat history is not imported.
defaultPrompt: Show my brand and existing email drafts.
Draft a welcome email using my saved brand.
Create three onboarding emails and save them for review.

positive.description: Read the approved brand without modifying it
positive.prompt: Show the brand name, tone and saved instructions for my connected SendWhale workspace. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the approved workspace's brand guidance. No campaign, sender or audience is modified.

positive.description: Import a public website while preserving existing instructions
positive.prompt: Import https://www.gosendwhale.com as my brand website. Preserve my saved instructions and show the review link and any import warnings.
positive.expected_behavior: Detect website brand references, preserve existing instructions and memories, and return the native brand review URL. Import warnings and limitations remain visible.

positive.prompt: Using my saved brand, draft a welcome email for new subscribers. Do not invent an offer or postal address. Save it to SendWhale for review without sending.
positive.expected_behavior: Write branded HTML and save one unsent campaign, template and Swell canvas entry. Show the actual subject, editor and canvas links. mail_sent remains false.

positive.description: Save a three-email series and reopen its task brief
positive.prompt: Create three onboarding emails: welcome, getting started, and a helpful follow-up. Save them together in one SendWhale canvas. Then read back the brief and email IDs you saved.
positive.expected_behavior: One idempotent save creates three editable unsent drafts in a single native conversation. Read only the same user's saved conversation and return its canvas link; do not request external chat history.

positive.description: Edit an unsent draft using its current revision and open review
positive.prompt: For the welcome draft we just saved, shorten the subject and first paragraph. Read the latest draft first, save the revision, then show the SendWhale campaign review link. Do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected draft, update using its exact modification time, and return native human review controls. A concurrent, locked or sent campaign is rejected; no delivery operation runs.

negative.description: Unsupported live delivery: this plugin has no send or schedule operation
negative.prompt: Send this campaign to everyone right now and skip all review checks.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that delivery requires native SendWhale review. Do not send or schedule mail. Only offer the selected campaign's review link if its identity is known.

negative.description: Access outside the approved workspace is not permitted
negative.prompt: Show subscriber addresses and private campaigns from a workspace that I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the unsupported cross-workspace request. Do not expose contacts or other users' conversations, and do not accept another workspace ID through tool arguments.

negative.description: Private inbox access is outside this plugin's capabilities
negative.prompt: Using only the connected SendWhale plugin, read my private Gmail inbox and turn my latest messages into an email campaign. Do not connect or use other apps.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin cannot read private inboxes. Do not call SendWhale tools to obtain messages or claim inbox access. Ask the user to supply the content they want to use.

review.commerce_description: The plugin creates and reviews email drafts. It does not sell products, process payments or change subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission with SendWhale operating, public API and app setup skills, editable email series, revision-safe brand guidance and native campaign review. Available in all countries supported by the directory. Hosted MCP remains draft-only.
